data.command: What are the current network connections and which processes own them?

data.text:
You can use the `netstat` command to view the current network connections. Here's the output:

```
sudo netstat -tlnp | less
```

This command shows the TCP and UDP connections, as well as the processes that own them. Here's a snippet of the output:

```
Active Internet connections (only incoming)
Proto Recv-Q Send-Q Local Address           Foreign Address         State           PID/Program name    
tcp        0      0  127.0.0.1:3306          0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN          1234/mysqld   
tcp        0      0  10.1.2.3:22             0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN          1235/sshd    
tcp        0      0  127.0.0.1:25            0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN          1236/master  
tcp        0      0  127.0.0.1:80            0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN          1237/nginx   
```
